articles.title: Signature Global-led consortium buys 194 acre land via auction for Rs 194 cr
articles.excerpt:

Signature Global will hold a 65 percent stake in the special purpose vehicle for this land. The management sees significant potential in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region property market.

articles.excerpt:

Forex traders said fresh foreign fund inflows and softer crude oil prices are supporting the rupee, while a stronger dollar and rising US yields remain key risks.

articles.title: Robust inflows, pullback in shorts lift rupee to seven-month peak
articles.excerpt:
The Indian rupee saw a notable rise, achieving its peak value in seven months following a surge in foreign equity investments. Closing at 93.47 per dollar, this upswing was driven by an impressive influx of $10 billion this month. Additionally, traders observed substantial movements in the dollar-rupee non-deliverable forward market as bearish positions were unwound.

articles.excerpt:

articles.title: Yen steady against euro and dollar after soft Japanese GDP data
articles.excerpt:
SINGAPORE, Nov 16 (Reuters) - The yen was pinned near two-month lows against the dollar and little moved against the euro in early trade on Monday as markets assessed how an unexpected contraction in the Japanese economy in the third quarter affects the policy outlook.

The yen fluctuated between gains and losses without moving too far, trading against the dollar at 159.69 yen and against the euro at 176.04 yen, close to levels where US and Japanese authorities are believed to have intervened earlier this year.
